# TotemVillagers 0.1.40

- Adult villagers can establish households, gather wood and plant fibre, craft basic tools and grow food or fish. Nearby players can see what villagers are doing and what supplies they need.
- Villages can train specialists as food reserves and demand permit. Both miners and lumberjacks can become builders when another worker can maintain their former supply.
- Miners and lumberjacks now continue searching beyond the first part of a work zone. Workers with an active job focus on that target, and miners can claim a replacement furnace when their original station becomes unavailable.
- Works with Minecraft 26.3, Fabric and Java 25. Requires Fabric API and TotemCore; TotemRemnant integration is optional.
